slices.title: Memory state and the single decision gate
slices.summary: Adds per-user memory state (on, paused, off) and one decision gate, memory_control::resolve, that every memory writer and reader consults under the same row lock, with content-free state events and the GetMemoryControls and SetMemoryControls RPCs. The default 'on' is behaviour-neutral.
test_commands: cargo test -q -p session-core --bin session-core -- --ignored --test-threads=1 pause_blocks_inline_and_dreaming_extraction resume_does_not_mine_messages_written_while_paused paused_user_still_gets_org_rows_and_no_user_rows off_hides_list_but_delete_still_works inflight_extraction_cannot_persist_after_pause zdr_caller_cannot_set_state (disposable DATABASE_URL)
cargo test -q -p session-core --bin session-core every_agent_memory_writer_calls_the_gate (source scan)

slices.title: Reset all memory
slices.summary: Adds a confirmed ResetMemory RPC that erases the caller's own durable memory rows, their supersession lineage and the semantic copies, leaves org-owned rows intact and records a content-free reset event.
test_commands: cargo test -q -p session-core --bin session-core -- --ignored --test-threads=1 reset_erases_user_rows_not_org_rows_and_blocks_remining reset_is_tenant_scoped reset_allowed_for_zdr_caller (disposable DATABASE_URL)

slices.title: Revisions, decide and undo
slices.summary: Records every skill change from any writer in a trigger-written revision log that carries the actor, and lets only the owner accept, reject or undo a learned skill, with undo restoring the before-snapshot and an owner-scoped ledger read.
